scope: Read-only existing primary/project evidence gate; no new web search, compiler execution, test execution, device access, HID operation or firmware change

gate_findings.claim: Official counter >2 supports an EvilDuck High Sierra classifier
gate_findings.reason: Official code distinguishes WINDOWS/LINUX with this threshold and does not specify the underlying counter event/reset/session contract.

gate_findings.claim: Missing LED reply means known MACOS
gate_findings.reason: Official fallback is heuristic; no independent positive High Sierra signature. Current strict Caps reads require actual fresh received evidence, whereas no received evidence stays unknown.

gate_findings.claim: Existing accepted Mac typing/LED trials supply the needed enumeration trace
gate_findings.reason: They demonstrate their scoped behavior only. The current HID trace carries operation/LED metadata, not the eight-byte SETUP headers or early enumeration ordering.

gate_findings.claim: A profile trained from the same known Mac establishes OS accuracy
gate_findings.reason: Same-host observations can establish repeatability, not uniqueness across operating systems or independent validation.

minimum_capture_question: Which early control-request header/order/lifecycle features, if any, support a reproducible positive High Sierra profile under unchanged EvilDuck USB descriptors?
capture_boundary: Only approved standard enumeration and HID initialization request headers; no transfer data, descriptor/string contents, HID report contents, keystrokes or host files.
Capture must be statically ready before Arduino starts USB; setup()/backend initialization is too late.
Use the approved first64-record/five-second foreground collection contract; overflow, late/incomplete capture, generation mismatch or absent validated rule cannot produce a positive OS result.
The observer can expose metadata only and must not present an always-UNKNOWN detector as a completed detection release.
positive_rule_gate: Trace-backed positive evidence for the unchanged profile.
Separate observations used to develop a rule from held-out observations used to validate it.
Independently justified discriminator or comparison evidence; classify ambiguity as UNKNOWN.
Known Mac results remain scoped; other operating systems stay untested unless separately observed.
owner_evidence: Three scoped DEFINE owner passes including Request3 line1/code6, blank output owner-reported; full running build ID and positive statuses unavailable. DEL passes stay accepted.
